title: Cloud Providers (runtime array)
description: Schema for the decrypted contents of config/cloud_providers.json. The file on disk is Fernet-encrypted; this describes the plaintext list. Written by core/cloud_config.save_provider(); read by core/providers/router.py.

provider.description: Canonical provider id. Must be one of the ids in config/providers.json (groq, gemini, openai, anthropic, openrouter, ollama, lmstudio, custom). 'home_assistant' is NOT an AI provider and must not appear here.

api_key.description: The secret. Encrypted at rest by core/cloud_config.py. Never logged, never returned to the UI in plaintext.

base_url.description: Overrides the registry base_url. Required for 'custom'.

model.description: Model identifier sent to the provider.

headers.description: Extra request headers, e.g. {"Authorization": "Bearer ..."}. Merged last, so they win over the derived auth header.

params.description: Extra JSON body parameters. Values keep their JSON types (numbers stay numbers, booleans stay booleans).

fallback.description: Ordered provider ids to try if this provider fails.

enabled.description: Whether this provider participates in routing. Default true.

priority.description: Lower sorts first within the auto chain. Default 100.
